detail.longDescription: timeout 20m in your crontab doesn't always stop the job. We timed out the same five jobs with GNU, uutils and busybox timeout, systemd and RunWisp. On Alpine, busybox left every child running. On Ubuntu 26.04, timeout -k kills the shell and not its children. # cron # linux # selfhosted https:// runwisp.com/blog/cron-job-time out/
